name: pandas-studio
description: Multi-CLI agent team patterns from pandas-studio's YouTube series. Each plugin packages a Claude-as-conductor pattern with companion CLIs (Antigravity, Codex) playing specialised roles.

plugins.name: dev-trio
plugins.description: Claude PM orchestrates a 3-vendor dev team: Antigravity (Researcher) + Codex (Reviewer); configurable model registry. Three-pane tmux view; bootstrap + research + review + install-pm skills.

plugins.name: debate-conductor
plugins.description: Claude conducts a Generator(Antigravity) vs Critic(Codex) adversarial debate over N rounds; configurable model registry. Three-pane tmux view; bootstrap + run + continue + install-pm skills.

plugins.name: ralph-trio
plugins.description: Ralph Wiggum loops — solo / trio / debate / meta variants. Iterative LLM-driven coder loop with planner+coder+reviewer (trio + meta depend on dev-trio's ask-agy.sh/ask-codex.sh; debate depends on debate-conductor). Optional Stop-hook in-session driver for solo.

plugins.name: spec-trio
plugins.description: Spec-anchored ralph-trio: an external spec.md gates planner / coder / reviewer with allowlist scope checks + §-citation coverage. Planner can request pre-coding research (Antigravity). Depends on dev-trio's ask-agy.sh/ask-codex.sh. bootstrap + install-pm skills.
